high_level_description: The Olympic Stadium of the UNAM university in Mexico City, a low curved stadium of volcanic stone with a colourful stone relief on its facade, under a vast blue sky.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A vast blue sky with a few white clouds over dark volcanic rock and green trees.

elements.desc: A wide low curved stadium built of dark volcanic stone, like a crater, with a colourful stone mosaic relief of figures and an eagle on its outer wall, with no letters.
Dark volcanic rock with succulents and dry grass in the foreground.
A few students walking with backpacks.
